dashboard.label: TA-throttle Overview
dashboard.description: Collects CPU frequency state from /sys/devices/system/cpu (per-core current/min/max frequency, governor) and hardware thermal-throttle counters (package_throttle_count,

panel.html: Commercial Use Commercial or production use of TA-throttle requires a paid license. Evaluation, personal, and lab use is free. See the BentleyPC Commercial License for full terms. Buy License License & Terms

search.query: | mstats avg("throttle.cpu_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("throttle.pkg_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("throttle.freq_avg_mhz") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

panel.title: Fixed governors in use (fleet, latest; 1=only one governor)

search.query: | mstats avg("throttle.governor_fixed") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

panel.title: Per-package throttle counters - latest per host

search.query: index=main sourcetype="throttle:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"throttle_count\"") | spath input=o path=throttle_count | spath input=o path=new | table host k throttle_count new
